description: This file defines the custom exception class 'ThingIdInvalidException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when a Thing's ID does not conform to the expected format. The class includes static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, as well as a nested builder class for constructing instances with specific properties.

classes.name: ThingIdInvalidException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class representing an invalid Thing ID error within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of 'ThingIdInvalidException' with customizable fields.

methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific invalid Thing ID.

methods.description: Creates a new builder for 'ThingIdInvalidException' with an optional initial Thing ID.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance by parsing details from a JSON object.

methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with specified headers.
